name: Collatz conjecture
target: Every orbit of T(n) = n/2 (n even), (3n+1)/2 (n odd) reaches 1
result: Open. The paper's Section 27.3 records CAND-STRONG with V_model = 1, but gives no candidate argument; Tao (2022) proves almost all orbits attain almost bounded values.
barriers: no uniform stopping-time bound for all n (lower gate defect 1.00 in Section 27.3)
Tao's logarithmic-density result does not exclude a divergent orbit or a nontrivial cycle
